office_does: The coroner investigates unattended, sudden or unnatural deaths in Franklin County and determines their cause and manner.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Coroner Curtis McGary (Prefers Republican Party), coroner for eight years, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Franklin County Coroner for eight years, trained in mortuary science; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Completed the county's first stand-alone morgue in October 2025, on time and under budget, by his account [S1]
Uses grants and CT scanning amid a forensic pathologist shortage [S1]
